items.title: Confirm or decline the offered childcare place
items.quote: Bitte sagen Sie uns binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zu oder ab.
items.computation: Letter is dated Thursday, 19.11.2026. This is a private provider, not an authority, so the general civil-law rule of § 187 Abs. 1 BGB applies: since the period is expressed as running 'ab' (from) a specific date, that date itself is not counted, and the period begins on the following day. Counting therefore starts on Friday, 20.11.2026, as 'Arbeitstag' day 1, counting only Monday-Friday and skipping public holidays (none fall in this window in NRW). Day-by-day: 20.11 Fri=1, 23.11 Mon=2, 24.11 Tue=3, 25.11 Wed=4, 26.11 Thu=5, 27.11 Fri=6, 30.11 Mon=7, 01.12 Tue=8, 02.12 Wed=9, 03.12 Thu=10, 04.12 Fri=11, 07.12 Mon=12. The 12th Arbeitstag is Monday, 07.12.2026, which is not a weekend day and needs no further shift (§193 BGB not needed as it already falls on a business day).

warnings: The exact starting point of the 'binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes' period is somewhat ambiguous: it is unclear whether the provider intends the letter's own date (19.11.2026) to count as the first working day, which would shift the deadline one business day earlier to Friday, 04.12.2026; if a strict reading is needed, confirm with the sender which interpretation they use.

This is a private childcare provider, not a public authority, so the statutory 3-day postal delivery fiction (Zugangsfiktion) for authority letters does not apply here; the deadline is explicitly tied to the letter's printed date, not to the date of receipt.
